title: Tech Note: Connecting 4D Databases through SOAP

historical_commentary.text: This is one of the earliest Tech Notes introducing 4th Dimension 2003's brand-new native SOAP support, framing SOAP-based Web Services as a way for one 4D database to interact with another. As a foundational, introductory-level note for a feature that was new at the time, it is now primarily of historical interest: SOAP-based inter-database Web Services have been superseded by REST/JSON-based approaches and, for many multi-database scenarios, by later 4D features like remote datastores/ORDA, though the fundamental idea of one 4D database calling into another over a web protocol remains conceptually current.
related_updates: 4D's web services capabilities have expanded well beyond SOAP to REST/JSON, now the standard approach for inter-application and inter-database connectivity
Later 4D features (remote datastores, ORDA client/server data access introduced from v16, 2018) offer more modern ways for 4D databases to connect to each other than SOAP-based Web Services
